photo_map_fitting: The U source and contained hexagonal497 align with the photographed street-corner tower and four-storey wings. Current-courtyard roof evidence is unresolved; the2014 white steel canopy is excluded without a demolition claim. Theater2367 remains independent.

actual_geometry_and_collision.method: Union actual raw/web/LOD indexed triangles clipped exactly to local z[0,2]; 0.08m mitre buffer and 0.05m topology-preserving simplification. No source footprint or overhead projection substitutes for ground; no artificial courtyard fill. Conservatively remove38 small concave outline vertices to form one valid256-point polygon; all actual low geometry remains covered, no added courtyard or neighbor overlap, and only4.325505590m² of local exterior padding is added.

asset_binding.method: Actual shipped GLTFLoader + MeshoptDecoder; visible scene meshes, referenced indices within drawRange, complete node world and instance matrices. Actual indexed triangles exported, not a convex-hull or accessor-only approximation. CPU only, no WebGL.

conservative_vertex_removal.method: Starting from the valid single-polygon actual-low-triangle union with0.08m buffer/0.05m simplification, remove one local concave/collinear vertex at a time in increasing added-area order. Accept only a valid polygon that retains all prior collision and actual raw/web/LOD low geometry, does not extend into the courtyard or any retained map/native neighbor, and adds no area beyond a0.6m buffer of actual low geometry. No global hull or footprint fallback.
conservative_vertex_removal.distance_bound_method: Bisection of conservative 32-quadrant-segment round buffers of actual low geometry; all added local padding is contained within the recorded upper bound.

runtime_collision_serialization_verifica.serialization_semantics: One valid polygon within the existing256-point closed-ring budget; no shared-edge serialization partitions.

camera_obstruction_precheck.method: Preliminary plan-height parallel rays from four approximate facade/tower points toward west-side cameras, 320m radius. Source heights estimated, not actual pixel visibility; final framing chosen by QA.
